title: Shatter Me
author: Tahereh Mafi
summary: A girl whose touch hurts anyone she contacts has been kept locked away for years. When a new cellmate arrives, she is pulled into a rebellion against the regime that controls her world.
readIf: you like a lyrical, intense young-adult dystopia with strong romance and superpowers.
skipIf: you want a restrained prose style, as the narration is extremely metaphor-heavy and emotional.

pairings.reason: Another young-adult dystopia with an unusual heroine who is drawn into resistance.
A tighter, more plot-driven story of a girl pushed to rebel against a cruel state.
A quick-moving dystopian romance with similarly high stakes.
